title: Triangle Solver
language: TRS-80 BASIC; extensions may be required
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: TRIANGLE SOLVER
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end; matching variants/repeated saves; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
100 PI=3.14159
200 INPUT"WHAT ARE SIDES A,B,C (ANSWER -1 IF YOU DON'T KNOW)";A(1),A(2),A(3)
220 INPUT"WHAT ARE ANGLES A,B,C IN DEGREES (ANSWER -1 IF YOU DON'T KNOW) ";A(4),A(5),A(6)
230 FOR C=4TO6:H=INT(A(C))+(A(C)-INT(A(C)))*10/6:A(C)=A(C)/180*PI:NEXTC
240 FOR C=1TO6
250 IF A(C)>0THEN F=F+1
260 NEXT C
270 IF F>=3 THEN F=0:GOTO 300
280 PRINT"SORRY NOT ENOUGH INFORMATION."
290 END
300 FOR C=4TO6
310 IF A(C)>0THEN F=F+1
